title: Summarize a document
description: Turn a long document into a useful brief for the people who need to read it.
example:
Purpose: explain a proposed process change.
Key points: what changes, who is affected and the next decision.
Open question: the document does not name an implementation owner.

Illustrative structure; findings and references come from your document.

fields.label: Audience
fields.placeholder: For example: branch staff, management or a project team

fields.label: Summary focus
fields.placeholder: For example: decisions, responsibilities, costs or changes
